That means advising businesses on how they preserve, optimize, raise and invest their capital to help them achieve their strategic objectives.

The right transaction can enhance an organization's growth, competitiveness and profitability. As a valuation professional at EY, you will help global organizations make strategic decisions by providing responsive, objective advice on valuing businesses, shares and assets. As a business modelling professional, you will carry out model review, model support and model build services to assist clients with their strategic decisions. Clients will see you as a vital part of their team. Furthermore, you'll gain valuable experience across industries and geographies as a member of a market-leading practice in what is currently the only globally integrated transactions services provider. And we'll give you the opportunities and support you will need to enjoy your work and achieve your potential.

At a time when the global business environment holds increasingly complex strategic challenges, we know that how organizations manage their capital agenda today will define their competitive position tomorrow.

Your key responsibilities:


You will be a core member of Valuation, Decision Modelling and Economics (VDME) team advising on business plans, transactions, decision support, optimization and review of all types of business for a diverse range of clients.
You will advise on the evaluation of all types of businesses, projects and securities, intangible assets and financial instruments. 
This could be for financial/tax reporting, mergers & acquisitions, advisory for capital transformation, investment and business growth plans. Strong understanding of concepts of corporate finance, valuation, accounting, and general Indonesian taxes

Excellent communication skills both in English and Indonesian, verbal and written
Proficient in financial modelling and data analysis using tools like Excel, Power BI, Phyton, etc is a plus
Experience in preparing capital budgeting, portfolio analysis and financial strategies is a plus
CFA or any professional designation is a plus

title: Product Analyst
job_description:
About the job

Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

Tripledot Studios is growing and looking for a Product Analyst to support some of our most ambitious game initiatives yet.

You’ll use real-time data, industry trends, and strong analytical thinking to help drive product decisions. You’ll refine ideas through experimentation and iteration, using data to validate hypotheses and uncover opportunities to improve game performance.

We’re open to candidates at different levels, including high-potential recent graduates with strong analytical and technical foundations, a curiosity for problem-solving, and a genuine interest in mobile games.

Identify areas for improvement, form hypotheses, and design A/B tests to improve core business metrics
Analyse large and complex datasets to answer strategic and operational questions
Deep dive into player behaviour (engagement, monetisation, retention, churn) to uncover insights
Conduct pre/post analysis to measure the impact of product changes

Support LiveOps and economy decisions through data insights
Translate data into clear, actionable recommendations that shape product direction

Strong interest in mobile games and free-to-play products
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex problems
Solid foundation in SQL and/or data analysis (academic or professional experience)
Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Excel, etc.)
Ability to interpret data and communicate insights clearly and concisely
Curious, resourceful, and comfortable working with ambiguity
Strong academic background in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or similar) and demonstrated hands-on experience with data (projects, internships, etc.)
Experience working with product or user data (internships, projects, or previous roles)
Familiarity with A/B testing or experimentation
Understanding of free-to-play monetisation, LiveOps, or game economy systems

The Associate NDT Tech / Radiation Associate Technician is responsible for managing all aspects of radiation safety within the organization. This role ensures compliance with regulations, promotes a strong safety culture, and implements effective radiation protection programs across operational activities.

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:


 Implement safety measures by regularly monitoring radiation exposure levels to ensure they remain within regulatory limits. This includes maintaining and updating radiation dose records and transparently communicating, monitoring the results to personnel.
 Ensure that all McDermott and NDT subcontractor personnel are kept informed of current developments in radiation safety practices and technologies.
 Promptly report any incidents of exposure exceeding dose limits to the Permit Holder and initiate appropriate corrective actions.
 Monitor all activities involving radioactive materials, including routine surveillance and special surveys of all operational areas where such materials are used.
 Ensure compliance with applicable laws, license conditions, and Area-specific / customer radiation safety requirements, including support the Permit Holder in verifying and reporting safety compliance to BAPETEN.
 Maintain strict control over the use, storage, and disposal of radioactive materials to prevent unauthorized access or environmental contamination.
 Provide expert consultation on all aspects of radiation protection to personnel at all levels. This includes providing technical and administrative instructions to radiation workers to ensure proper implementation of safety procedures.
 Manage the receipt, inspection, and documentation of all incoming shipments of radioactive materials, as well as the preparation and shipment of outgoing materials in accordance with regulatory standards.
 Distribute and manage personnel monitoring equipment, assess the need for bioassay evaluations, maintain exposure and bioassay records, and notify individuals and supervisors of exposures approaching permissible limits with recommended remedial actions.
 Coordinate with Permit Holder to identify training needs, organize, and conduct radiation safety training programs and ensure personnel are properly instructed prior to using radioactive materials and whenever procedures, equipment, or regulations change.
 Exercise the authority to immediately suspend any activity or project that poses a threat to health, safety, or property. This includes executing emergency response actions during radiation-related incidents.
 Supervise and coordinate the radioactive waste disposal program, including the documentation of storage and disposal records and the monitoring of effluents.
 Maintain an accurate inventory of all radioactive materials and ensure that radionuclide quantities remain within licensed limits.
 Carry out sampling for leak tests of sealed radioactive sources and X-ray tubes and maintain corresponding records.
 Promote and implement the principles of ALARA (As Low as Reasonably Achievable) in all radiation-related activities to minimize exposure risks.
 Maintain comprehensive records related to radiation protection activities, including those not specifically designated above, such as receipt, transfer, survey, procedural documentation, evaluations, and compliance records.
 Regularly review and assess the effectiveness of the radiation protection and safety program and recommend improvements to enhance its implementation and outcomes.
 Ensure the availability, suitability, and proper use of radiation protection equipment, and monitor its condition and usage to maintain operational integrity.
 Implement access control measures in designated radiation-controlled areas to ensure that only authorized personnel are permitted entry.
 Prepare and submit periodic reports on the execution of Associate NDT Tech/ Radiation Associate Technician) duties, including documented evidence of compliance and performance, at least twice annually, as required by BAPETEN.

 Holds BAPETEN Work Permit as RSO

 Minimum two plus (2+) years of technical or relevant experience.

What will I be doing? 

As the Front Office Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:


 Maintain high customer service focus by approaching your job with the customers always in mind.
 Have a positive impact, taking personal responsibility and initiative to resolve issues, always clearly communicating with both customers and colleagues.
 Motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seizing opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve your personal performance.
 Be flexible, responding quickly and positively to changing requirements including the performance of any tasks requested of you.
 Maintain high team focus by showing cooperation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.
 Contribute ideas and suggestions to enhance operational / environmental procedures in the hotel.
 Actively promote the services and facilities of Hilton hotels to guests and suppliers of the hotel.
 Actively seek verbal feedback from customers and team members at every opportunity.
 Agree and implement actions to make improvements to customer service.
 Positively dealing with and learn from customer complaints and comments with follow-up and feedback to the Director of Operations.

 Maintain a presence in the lobby setting the example for team members for guest service.
 Be proactive towards guests, assisting them with any reasonable requests, and training all team members to see these things before the guests ask.
 Have detailed knowledge of Hilton departmental standards, explaining the standards to the team and training each team member individually with specific job skills checklists that relate to their responsibilities.
 Assess team members’ performance against standards.
 Monitor standards through regular standards review checks.
 Develop action plans to address shortfalls in standards and identify shortfalls before they affect customer service.
 Implement and follow through with improvements identified.
 Demonstrate positive leadership characteristics which inspire team members to meet and exceed standards.

 Sett and agree to departmental objectives for self and team.

 Create and implement sales promotions and team members incentives as per discussion with the Director of Operations.

title: AI Solutions Engineer (Engineering Infrastructure) - Sea Labs
job_description:
About the job

About the Team:

The Engineering and Technology team is at the core of the Shopee platform development. The team is made up of a group of passionate engineers from all over the world, striving to build the best systems with the most suitable technologies. Our engineers do not merely solve problems at hand; We build foundations for a long-lasting future. We don't limit ourselves on what we can or can't do; we take matters into our own hands even if it means drilling down to the bottom layer of the computing platform. Shopee's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience it first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do.

About Team

The AI Solutions team builds and pioneers the future of AI-driven automation at Sea. We are the developers of Smart (Sea Multi-Agent Realization Platform) - the company's flagship AI agents platform that enables teams across the company to automate their workflows using large language model (LLM) agents. But Smart is just the beginning.

Our team is also spearheading a wide range of AI initiatives, especially within the engineering infrastructure domain, from internal developer tooling to intelligent operations. We believe that the future of infrastructure lies in intelligent automation, and we’re committed to building it from the ground up.

We thrive in a fast-paced, sharing-first culture, with a strong emphasis on learning, creativity, and experimentation. We work hard and play hard, explore ideas on the cutting edge, and aim to pioneer bold, practical solutions to complex real-world problems. If you want to shape how AI changes engineering at scale - this is the place.

Job Description:


Design and develop the Smart platform and other AI systems, covering all essential agent platform components - agent runtimes, toolchains, memory, orchestration, logging, planning, and sandboxing.
Collaborate with teams across departments - both tech and non-tech - to land and scale real-world AI use cases.
Drive internal agent adoption in engineering infra by replacing traditional operations with intelligent agent workflows.
Work on platform reliability and observability to ensure our systems are performant, debuggable, and production-ready.
Support operations and development work in a healthy balance - you’ll gain experience in shipping features and running real services.
Manage and operate supporting infrastructure, including vector stores, retrieval systems (RAG), and middleware components.
Continuously experiment, learn, and bring in the latest advancements from the AI/agent ecosystem into production.
Continuously optimize system performance through tuning, profiling, and root-cause analysis.
Design and develop an automated technical operations platform to reduce manual work and improve reliability.
Drive capacity and resource management, ensuring systems scale efficiently under varying workloads.
Plan and execute stress tests and load tests to identify bottlenecks, improve throughput, and eliminate redundancy.
Improve system reliability, availability, and observability through better monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response practices.
Troubleshoot complex production issues across application, middleware, and infrastructure layers.



Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
2+ years of relevant experience in software development - or fresh graduates with strong fundamentals and hunger to learn.
Strong programming skills in Python (primary) - familiarity with Golang is a plus.
Solid CS fundamentals - algorithms, data structures, networking, systems, and architecture.
Backend experience designing cloud-ready services using databases, queues, caching, etc.
Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or strong interest in learning them.
Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to navigate ambiguity with curiosity and creativity.
Willingness to work full stack - we prioritize backend but value well-rounded engineers.
General understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native principles (e.g. the twelve-factor app), including how services are deployed, scaled, and load-balanced in a containerized environment.
Passion for building AI systems that people actually use.



Skills below are optional but preferred:


Experience building AI-powered platforms, assistants, or automation tools.
Familiarity with agent patterns like ReAct (Reasoning and Action), tool chaining, or multi-agent orchestration.
Knowledge of RAG systems, vector databases, or prompt tuning.
Prior experience in developer tools, internal platforms, or large-scale systems.
Exposure to observability, debugging, incident workflows, or service reliability.

About The Role

MIS Analyst are the crucial link between our core operational systems and business decision-makers. In this role, you will take ownership of data quality within our Odoo ERP, manage the routine data pipelines that feed our analytics, and ensure our Looker Studio dashboards are accurate and available every morning.




This is not a data science role; this is an operational data management role. You will liberate senior team members from daily reporting tasks, functioning as the gatekeeper of data integrity. If you have an "eagle eye" for numerical errors and take pride in systems that run like clockwork, this is your platform.

Must-Have Qualifications:

Experience: 2-4 years in an MIS, Data Analyst, or ERP support role, preferably within FMCG or Manufacturing.
ERP Expertise: Hands-on experience managing data within an ERP system. (Odoo experience is a major plus; SAP/NetSuite acceptable with willingness to learn).
SQL Skills: Strong ability to write SQL queries to validate data, join tables, and troubleshoot discrepancies.
Visualization: Proficiency with Google Looker Studio (formerly Data Studio).




Ideal Mindset:

Process-Driven: You prefer established workflows over experimental chaos.
Detail-Obsessed: You spot the one wrong number in a spreadsheet of thousands.
Operational: You understand that a dashboard is useless if it isn't updated by 8:00 AM.




What You Will Do

Act as the primary gatekeeper for data integrity within Odoo ERP across Sales, Inventory, and Procurement modules.
Diagnose and resolve data discrepancies between physical inventory and Odoo system records.
Collaborate with department heads to enforce standardized data entry processes to prevent bad data at the source.

Build new, standardized operational reports based on requirements from Finance and Sales teams.

Monitor and maintain existing data pipelines (KNIME/ETL tools), ensuring successful daily execution.
Perform basic modifications to workflows to accommodate minor changes in business logic or data structures.
Identify manual data entry bottlenecks and propose automation solutions.

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Clear ownership of a critical business function—you are not just a cog in the wheel.
Opportunity to upskill in KNIME, ETL workflows, and advanced ERP management.
An impact-driven role where your work directly supports executive decisions.

About the job

About the Role

In this role, you will support the development and adoption of AI-driven tools and solutions that improve internal workflows and team productivity. You will work closely with different teams to explore new technologies, build simple prototypes, support best practices, and help measure the impact of these solutions across the organization.

What You Will Do


Support Agentic Workflows: Participate in the development of AI-powered automations that streamline internal engineering and operational processes — learning how these systems are designed and shipped end-to-end.
Explore MCP & AI Tooling: Get hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools that connect AI agents to internal systems, APIs, and data sources.
Support AI Adoption: Help teams integrate AI tools like Claude Code and Kiro into their daily workflows. Be the person who finds new ways to make things faster.
Contribute to Governance & Security: Support the AI team in evaluating AI tools, documenting best practices, and helping establish guidelines for safe, responsible usage across the organization.
Prototype & Learn: Build small internal tools, bots, or proof-of-concepts that demonstrate the potential of agentic AI — with guidance and mentorship from the team.
Measure Impact: Help track and quantify efficiency gains from AI adoption — time saved, automation coverage, and developer experience improvements.


What We Are Looking For


Agentic AI Curiosity: You have been tinkering with tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro, or similar AI-native development tools. You don't need to be an expert — but you should be excited about what these tools can do. You should aware how how such tools can have their capabilities expanded (e.g. through MCPs, Skills)
The "100x" Mindset: You are obsessed with efficiency. You look at a 10-step manual process and immediately think about how to reduce it to one. You believe AI should be doing most of the repetitive work so humans can focus on what matters.
Language Agnostic: You've tinkered with at least one backend language (e.g., Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby) and are eager to learn whatever gets the job done.
Tools: Familiarity with Git for version control.
Mindset: A "can-do" attitude, a love for trying new AI tools the day they launch, a strong desire to learn, and the ability to communicate your ideas clearly.
Bonus Points: Experience with workflow orchestration tools (n8n, LangChain, etc.), familiarity with LLM APIs, or an interest in Fintech, Crypto, or how money moves globally.
